sources.observed: The release's exact source scores the standalone SAT/ASM envelope at L1 while describing selected typed solved-record transfer to connected neutral B-rep. Its format notes distinguish ACIS BinaryFile save formats 217/218 from ASM BinaryFile4 and BinaryFile8, whose tag integer/reference width differs. It publishes record-family open items and score criteria covering real-file evidence, byte disposition, loss reporting, deterministic decode, generated re-decode, geometry/topology validity, and fuzzing.
sources.limits: The release was not downloaded or run. Its own profile and source do not prove the behavior of a particular libdxfrw-extracted payload, complete support across all body records, an independent kernel result, DWG/AcDs ownership, or native CAD acceptance. Self-authored reverse-engineering documentation is a candidate-profile description, not the ODA DWG byte-layout authority.

sources.observed: Local carrier admission tracks ACIS BinaryFile and ASM BinaryFile4 as distinct signatures. Existing consumer contract states that byte/association evidence covers only named local cases, not general semantic solid support.
sources.limits: Source-level signature recognition or a nonempty extracted payload does not prove a candidate parser accepts that exact format, reconstructs a connected valid body, or agrees with an independent native consumer.

decision.planDelta: Tightened the existing optional semantic comparison. It now requires inspection of the extracted bytes' exact signature family, save/header words, BinaryFile4/8 reference width, modeler stamp, and digest before selecting a parser. ACIS 217/218 claims cannot be inherited by an ASM-family carrier. Candidate semantic output must account for all body-reachable records and be compared with independently authored topology and analytic expectations; parser completeness, kernel validity, owner association, and native consumer acceptance remain separate.

implementationReadyChecks: Complete and record the local entity -> DataStorage record -> Blob01 page -> exact SAB byte join and owner identity before passing a payload to a bare-stream parser.
Select no fallback: record exact magic/signature, version words, reference width, modeler version, payload digest, and target body identity; require exact candidate profile overlap.

Require strict candidate completion and every body-reachable record to be typed, validated-opaque with stated nonparticipation, or a failure; unknown topology, placement, transform, or carrier on the body path fails the semantic check.

Use a source-authored analytic manifest for connected component/topology counts, orientation/closure, units/transforms, bounding box, area, and volume; report parser graph checks and kernel validity separately.
Label candidate profile mismatch NOT_APPLICABLE and missing runtime NOT_RUN, then continue local implementation; do not add peer binaries or fixture files to regular build/test workflows.
